en-US.description: Asterisk - Outlook integration (click2dial and popup recognition)
en-US.longDescription: OutCALL is an application designed for integration with Microsoft Outlook while placing and receiving phone calls. The application includes: Outlook contacts integration, incoming calls pop-up window notification, click to dial from contact.
en-US.name: OutCALL
